headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: 1 | P a g e ( 5 t h N o v 2 0 2 6 ) For any further query, please email us on research@venturasecurities.com V2 Retail Ltd Q2FY27 Result Update 2 | P a g e ( 5 t h N o v 2 0 2 6 ) For any further query, please email us on research@venturasecurities.com V2 Retail reported consolidated revenue of INR 905.6 crore in Q2FY27, up 28% YoY, supported by strong volume growth and aggressive store expansion.
Gross profit stood at INR 281.3 crore, up 42% YoY, with gross margin expanding to 31.1% (vs 28.0% YoY), reflecting improved merchandising and product mix.
EBITDA stood at INR 120.3 crore, up 41% YoY, with EBITDA margin expanding to 13.3% (vs 12.1% YoY), supported by gross margin improvement despite higher employee and operating expenses.
For H1FY27, EBITDA increased 50% YoY to INR 259.7 crore, with margin improving to 13.6% (vs 12.9%).
valuation: Valuation call – We recommend a BUY rating on V2 Retail with a target price of INR 197 (17.7X FY29 P/E), representing a 21% upside.

Management plans another 60–70 store openings in H2FY27, while FY28 additions are targeted at 120–150 stores, depending on demand recovery. • Q2FY27 SSSG declined 14.9%, primarily due to the Durga Puja festival shift, while normalised SSSG remained marginally positive at 0.5%.

Management expects 5– 7% normalised SSSG in Q3FY27 and targets 7–9% SSSG from existing stores during H2FY27. • Management acknowledged underlying demand weakness beyond the festive shift, with October's festival-adjusted SSSG remaining flat.
